findings.title: The tide chart has no scale

location.description: The bar chart at the top of the hero panel.

findings.viewer_experience: A swimmer sees a row of bars and cannot tell what height means, or which bar is now.

current.value: 24 bars, no axis, no time labels, no marker for now.

findings.target: A viewer can read the time and the tide height of any bar.
findings.fix_direction: Label the hours and mark the current one.
findings.source: Tufte, The Visual Display of Quantitative Information (labelling)

closed_when.check: Looking at the chart, the hours are labelled and the current bar is marked.

findings.title: The two plans have no way to choose them

location.description: The Dipper and Year-rounder columns near the foot.

findings.viewer_experience: A visitor who has chosen a plan has nothing to press.

current.value: Names, prices and descriptions with no button or link.

findings.target: Each plan leads to a next step.
findings.fix_direction: Add one clear action to each plan.
findings.source: Nielsen Norman Group, call to action guidance

closed_when.check: Looking at the plans, each has an action.

findings.title: The plans fill only two thirds of the row

location.description: The right third beside the two plans.

current.value: Two columns over three columns' width.

findings.target: The plans sit in a row that looks complete.
findings.fix_direction: Space the plans across the row or give them a better fit.

closed_when.check: Looking at the row, it does not look unfinished.
